questions.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'What Safeguarding Means'? Select all that apply.

questions.prompt: How does the deck define radicalisation?
options: The process by which someone comes to support terrorism or forms of extremism that lead to terrorism
questions.explanation: Radicalisation is the process by which someone comes to support terrorism or forms of extremism that lead to terrorism.

questions.prompt: Which phrase from the deck captures the Prevent message about debating politics?
options: Exploring ideas and debating politics is fine - and encouraged. Being pushed toward hatred of a group of people is not the same thing.
questions.explanation: Exploring ideas and debating politics is fine - and encouraged. Being pushed toward hatred of a group of people is not the same thing.

questions.prompt: What does the deck say about personal data and public AI tools?
options: Do not enter personal data into public AI tools - your name, address, college login, or details about other students or staff
Only enter it if logged in
questions.explanation: Do not enter personal data into public AI tools.

questions.prompt: Which of these are part of the four-step safeguarding process? Select all that apply.
options: The right person is told same-day
questions.explanation: All four are the steps: Something is raised -> right person told same-day -> concern assessed -> confidentiality honest about its limits.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: ESCG uses ____ for filtering and monitoring.
questions.template: ESCG uses ____ for filtering and monitoring.
questions.explanation: ESCG uses Smoothwall for filtering and monitoring.

questions.prompt: Which is the deck's reframe of telling someone you're worried about a friend?
options: It's the right thing to do - it's not a betrayal
It must wait until you're sure
Only your tutor can do it
questions.explanation: Acting on concern for a friend is the right thing. It is not a betrayal.

questions.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'College Is Different from School'? Select all that apply.
options: You make more of your own decisions
questions.explanation: All of these are mentioned in the section on College Is Different from School.

questions.prompt: Which routes can you use to report a concern about yourself? Select all that apply.
options: Talk to any member of staff you trust
Go directly to the Safeguarding Manager
Contact the Wellbeing Team - no referral needed
questions.explanation: All four are routes you can use if you are worried about yourself.
